title: xtralab Git Diff
description: Display options for the git diff views in the launcher and the Git panel.

diffStyle.title: Layout
diffStyle.description: Show text diffs side by side (split) or in one column (unified).

diffStyleControl.title: Layout buttons
diffStyleControl.description: Show two toolbar buttons for the split and unified layouts (buttons), or one button that switches between them (toggle).

lineWrap.title: Wrap long lines
lineWrap.description: When true, long lines in text diffs wrap to the width of the view. When false, they scroll horizontally.

notebookViewMode.title: Notebook diff view
notebookViewMode.description: Show notebook diffs cell by cell (notebook) or as the diff of the notebook JSON (json).

imageViewMode.title: Image diff view
imageViewMode.description: Compare images side by side (2-up), with a slider (swipe), or overlaid (onion).
